run_unpack_goliath_dataset: run the CLI to unpack a Goliath dataset zip archive from input to output directory
run_unpack_dataset_in_place: run the unpack script in-place on a dataset directory to extract all zipped contents
unzip_images_parallel: unzip all image zip files under a dataset's image directory using 8 parallel processes
unzip_kinematic_tracking: unzip kinematic tracking data including pose and registration vertices for Body, Head, or Hand datasets
copy_misc_dataset_files: copy camera calibration and frame list CSV files from input to output dataset directory
